race.description: Hawkesbury Race Club Motel Mdn Plate
race.comment: NOT ON MY WATCH (10) started hard in the market on debut with a fighting on-pace second in the small field over 1100m at Gosford. Gets the right set-up again and doesn't have to improve much to win this. CAMDEN COVE (1) Hallowed Crown gelding from Coves on debut for the Baker yard. Has won his last two trials in excellent fashion and has the speed to overcome the sticky gate. Go close. SOVIET STORM (8) four-year-old gelding by Russian Revolution from Calzini Bianchi on debut for the Portelli camp. Has trialled well on four occasions leading into today's race. Has genuine top four prospects. MARKOS PORT (5) Hellbent gelding from Sweet Reply on debut for the Waterhouse & Bott stable. Latest trial had merit and keep safe.
